youNeedEditAccessTo: You need edit access to import
aSummaryMarkdownOrText: A summary (Markdown or text) or a transcript (.vtt, .srt) from your notes app becomes one frame: decisions, action items with owner and due date, and the other points. One undo takes it back.
forTranscriptsAddWhoSpoke: For transcripts, add who spoke and for how long
droppingAVttOrSrt: Dropping a .vtt or .srt file on the board imports it too.
